Packages with their versions, purposes and citations (Table S8 of the Supplementary Materials) and the dataset. Paths: `R/paths.R`;
packages and the loading of the data: `R/setup.R`. Data: the final dataset after verification against the publications (viability
0-200 %).

```{r setup-module, include=FALSE}
source("R/setup.R", local = knitr::knit_global())
```

### 1.1 Packages, versions, purpose and citations

Only the packages the modules use (loaded in `R/setup.R`); the citation of each comes from its own `citation()`.
Not listed: knitr and rmarkdown (rendering of the HTML reports) and the base packages stats, utils, grid (part of R).

```{r}
used_for <- c(
  R = "analyses and figures; base package stats: PCA (prcomp), Welch t, Wilcoxon and Kruskal-Wallis tests, likelihood-ratio tests, correlations, Holm adjustment",
  dplyr = "data handling",
  stringr = "string operations (organ labels of Figure 2)",
  forcats = "ordering of the categories in the bar charts (Figures S6-S8)",
  ggplot2 = "figures (incl. viridis colour scales)",
  patchwork = "multi-panel figures (Figures S2 and S9)",
  cowplot = "two-panel PCA / t-SNE figures with a shared legend (Figure 1, Figure S1)",
  ggh4x = "nested facets (Figure 2)",
  ggrepel = "non-overlapping labels of the PCA arrows",
  readxl = "reading the dataset (xlsx)",
  effsize = "effect size of coated vs uncoated (Cohen's d)",
  car = "Levene's test of equal variances (coated vs uncoated)",
  lme4 = "linear mixed-effects models",
  pbkrtest = "Kenward-Roger F-tests of the mixed models",
  emmeans = "coated vs uncoated contrasts within each nanomaterial (mixed model)",
  Rtsne = "t-SNE"
)
packages <- setdiff(names(used_for), "R")
cite_text <- function(pkg) {  # every entry of the package's own citation(), plain text
  ci <- if (pkg == "R") citation() else citation(pkg)
  txt <- vapply(seq_along(ci), function(i) paste(format(ci[i], style = "text"), collapse = " "), character(1))
  paste(gsub("\\s+", " ", gsub("[_*]|<|>", "", txt)), collapse = " || ")
}
versions_df <- data.frame(
  Package = names(used_for),
  Version = c(paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = "."), vapply(packages, function(x) as.character(packageVersion(x)), character(1))),
  Used_for = unname(used_for),
  Citation = vapply(names(used_for), cite_text, character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
print(versions_df[, c("Package", "Version", "Used_for")], row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(versions_df, out("tables", "package_versions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# citations as given by the packages
for (i in seq_len(nrow(versions_df))) cat("=== ", versions_df$Package[i], " ===\n", gsub(" \\|\\| ", "\n", versions_df$Citation[i]), "\n\n")
```
